description: Player 2's deck for the Sheepish spec: #41 Sheepish and nineteen cards the spec never plays. Sheepish is the only Trap in either deck, so the face-down card in player 2's backrow can only be that one and the trap that fires on player 1's turn is unambiguous. Nothing else here is a Trap, a Field Trap, a Cast-on-draw card or a Quickdraw card, and every card is choice-free at play time, so player 2's turns are a bare set-and-pass.
